full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. On an application under section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure this rule was issued calling upon the Deputy Commissioner, Joypurhat to show cause as to why the detenu Tamima Akhter Mitu, the victim girl as alleged in Joypurhat P.S. Case No.18(5)2010 dated 15.05.2010 started under section 7(30) of the Nari-O-Shishu Daman Ain,2000 as amended upto, 2003 shall not be released from the jail custody in which she has been kept from 11.07.2010 illegally and without lawful authority and she shall not be brought before this court to be dealt with in accordance with law. 

 Facts relevant for disposal of the rule are that on 15.5.2010 one Md. Mamunur Rashid lodged an FIR with the Joypurhat police station against 3 accused persons alleging that the accused Mostafizar  @ Chapal used to teach his daughter  named Most. Tamima Akhter Mitu, a girl aged about 14 years and she is a student of Class- X of Jamalganj Demukhi High School and on the way of her school but her refusal the accused person threat her to kidnap and on her information the informant informed the matter to the parents of Mustafizar Rahman. Thereafter on 08.05.2010 at about 5.00 p.m while his daughter went on natural call from his house but thereafter she did not return home, at one stage of their searching he came to know that the accused Musatfizar Rahman kidnapped her. He then put pressure to get back her daughter upon the accused persons but failed then he lodged the instant case. Accordingly a case under section 7/30 of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain( amended -2003) was started against the accused persons. Thereafter on 8.6.2010 the accused  Mustafizur  Rahman  along  with his  parents got anticipatory  bail  from  the  Hon’ble  High  Court  Division  in Criminal Misc. Case No. 18056 of 2010.Thereafter The said Mustafizar Rahman along with  his Parents and the victim surrendered before the court below, but by the order dated 8.6.2010  the  learned  Magistrate  took  custody to accused Mustafizar Rahman along with the victim and the victim was sent to the Judicial Custody. Thereafter the petitioner filed this application under section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for releasing the detenu Tamima Akhter Mitu from the judicial custody and obtained the instant rule.
